title: Bridge
body:
The Bridge is a landmark in Oaklands. It connects Finlay to Ferwater.

Previous functionality

When first added to the game, the bridge had a short span in the middle that was a drawbridge. Both the Finlay Island and Ferwater Island sides of the bridge were manned by the Hyper Bridgeman and Sleepy Bridgeman respectively. For whatever reason, the bridgemen can't operate the bridge correctly.

For the bridge to come down, the player had to complete a "Simon Says" memory game by interacting with a panel with six buttons. These buttons flashed in a specific order. When initially added, the memory game went for a full 6 rounds, but it was later reduced to 3 rounds, before eventually becoming completely bypassed and simply activated by talking to either NPC. Once the memory game had been completed, the bridge would lower, allowing players to cross it. The bridge would then remain lowered for approximately 4 minutes, after which it would raise, and the memory game needed to be completed again.

Current functionality

After the island expansion update,the bridge was no longer a drawbridge and is just a normal bridge. The bridgemen were relocated, making it just a very plain normal bridge.

Trivia

  • The bridge minigame received poor reception due to how tedious it was. It also would lag under any conditions that caused server lag, making it nearly impossible to complete under those conditions.
